The Pappos dossier points to Kohelet Rabbah on Ecclesiastes 9:10 and explicitly records the dream about Alexandri.

The complete Acha transmission and its relationship to the preceding Shimon bar Yochai notice remain to be located. Tried Berakhot chapter 9 and its opening halakhah in the digital witnesses; the named chain was not secured.

Heilprin’s possible identification and his printed foliation remain open. The named story was read in the digital edition with a conventional locator. It does not connect this Acha to the earlier transmitted baraita.
The Va’etchannan locator and the reported companion Elazar son of Shimon remain open. Targeted Va’etchannan and exact-name search did not produce the cited passage with both named figures.
